prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 handheld news-camera frame on a hot November afternoon in a residential street in Asunción. The reporter wears a crumpled black suit and a cream roll-neck, and his whole head is covered by a cream and oatmeal rib-knit wool balaclava, one continuous unbroken knitted surface where the face would be, pilled and fuzzy. A large white felt ring edged in dark brown thread is stitched around the face area, and a small filled solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside the ring at two o'clock, on the right side of the image. Brown leather gloves, each with a thumbnail-sized white ring and red triangle patch on the back. Harsh overhead sun, hard shadows, cracked pavement, a stray plastic chair, slightly soft focus behind.
